what: Computation Tools for Genetically Regulated Omics with PGEN Streaming
title: Computation Tools for Genetically Regulated Omics with PGEN Streaming
text: gromtools package enables high-throughput imputation genetically regulated omics values chromosome-split PLINK2 genotype data using additive linear SNP models. Major functionality gromtools package: read_db_dir()                Load model SQLite databases weights table grom_impute()  Build sparse weights write .grom, .gid, .sid outputs grom_read()        Stream selected model, gene, sample combinations existing .grom output

title: Computation Tools for Genetically Regulated Omics with PGEN Streaming
Computation Tools for Genetically Regulated Omics with PGEN Streaming
text: Large-scale genetically regulated omics workflows need compact interface loading prediction weights, streaming genotype data, writing output format can read back efficiently without materializing full matrix memory. gromtools built around workflow. converts model weights sparse binary representation, streams chromosome-split .pgen inputs, computes predicted values using additive SNP effects, writes result -disk .grom matrix matching .gid .sid index files. package designed around three user-facing steps: read model databases, run imputation, read back selected results. Example synthetic inputs full workflow bundled package.

title: Computation Tools for Genetically Regulated Omics with PGEN Streaming
Computation Tools for Genetically Regulated Omics with PGEN Streaming
text: package requires R, Rcpp, working C++17 toolchain, GNU make, data.table. configure can optionally detect Intel MKL MKLROOT, can also build without MKL.

code: grom_impute(   weights_table,   grom_pfx,   pgen_dir,   snp_chunk = 1000L,   sample_subset = integer(0),   CHUNK = 1000L,   exportChunk = 256L,   meanimpute = TRUE,   is_round = TRUE )

title: Impute genetically regulated omics values — grom_impute
text: weights_table `data.frame` `data.table` model weights. grom_pfx Output prefix generated grom files. pgen_dir Path directory containing PLINK2 `.pgen`, `.pvar`, `.psam` files. snp_chunk Integer chunk size used streaming SNPs. sample_subset Optional integer vector 1-based sample indices retain. CHUNK Integer chunk size passed low-level imputation engine. exportChunk Integer chunk size used exporting results. meanimpute Logical indicating whether missing dosages mean imputed. is_round Logical indicating whether mean imputation use rounded means.
